description: This file contains the implementation of the ConnectTabScreen composable function for an Android app, which manages UI related to connecting to a gateway, including connection status, configuration, advanced controls, and diagnostics. It uses Jetpack Compose and interacts with a ViewModel for state management.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: Enum class representing input modes for connection setup: SetupCode or Manual.

methods.name: MethodChip
methods.description: Composable button representing a selectable connection method chip, indicating whether it's active.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Composable button for quick input presets, like 'Android Emulator' or 'Localhost'.

methods.name: CommandBlock
methods.description: Displays a styled command string block, typically for CLI commands.

methods.name: EndpointPreview
methods.description: Shows a preview of the resolved endpoint URL.

methods.name: outlinedColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for outlined text fields.
